slides.title: A ticket for every fault **was the fault**
slides.scene: Two friendly cartoon robots stand in a small office drowning in an ever-growing avalanche of paper tickets pouring out of a printer; one robot frantically staples, the other calmly holds up a single neatly folded ticket like a waiter presenting the bill. Funny, bright, no phone characters.

items.text: tickets opened in one week. 36 closed
open, because nobody measured fill rate against drain rate
tickets from one 25-minute outage that had already ended
of open error tickets were one job's failures, filed twice
